question: Six years ago, Rahim was P times as old as Kalam was. If Rahim is now 17 years old, how old is Kalam now in terms of P?
explanation:
🔖Let, kalams present age be x
then, 17 - 6 = P(x - 6)
11 = P(x-6)
11/p = x -6
x = 11/p + 6

y kg at 60/kg rate

question: P starts jogging from point X to point Y. 30 minutes later his friend R who jogs 1 km/hour slower than twice P's rate starts from the same point and follows the same path. If R overtakes P in 2 hours, how many kilometres will R have covered?
explanation:
🔖Let, s Ps rate = v per hour
R, s rate = ( 2v - 1)
P walks total = ( 2 + 1/2) hour
R walks total = 2 hour
P, s distance = R's distance
v ×( 2 + 1/2) = 2 ( 2v - 1) = 4v - 2
v ×5/2 = 4v - 2
3v/2 = 2
v = 4/3 and R's distance = 4 ×4/3 - 3 = 3.33

question: A worker was hired for 7 days. Each day, he was paid Tk. 10 more than what he was paid for the previous day of work. The total amount he was paid in the first 4 days of work equaled the total amount he was paid in the last 3 days. What was his starting pay?
explanation:
🔖Let, the first day pay be x
1st day = x
2nd day = x + 20
3rd day = x + 30
4th day = x + 30
Total = x + x+10+x+20+x+30 = 4x + 60
5th day = x+40
6th day = x + 50
7th day = x + 60
Total = x+40+x+50+x+60 = 3x + 150
4x + 60 = 3x + 150
x = 90
